high_level_description: The image is a scanned page from "The Washington Star" dated October 31, 1979. The article is titled "Rockefeller dinners draw gilt-edged VIPs" by Betty Beale. The page appears to be from the "Green Line" section of the newspaper. The event described takes place in Washington, D.C., specifically at the National Portrait Gallery for an informal dinner on Sunday night and at Anderson House for a black-tie dinner on Monday night.
